title: Permissions for "{name}"
setuidHint: Runs as the file's owner, regardless of who starts it.
setgidHint: Runs as the file's group — in a folder, new entries inherit its group.
stickyHint: In a folder, everyone may only delete or rename their own entries.
recursiveHint: Applies to all folders and files below. Folders get {folders}, files {files} — without the execute permission, which only files that already have it keep. This cannot be undone.
